<body style="visibility: hidden;">

    <div class="game-container">

        <h1>🎯 Hangman</h1>

        <div class="subtitle">
            Guess the hidden word!
        </div>

        <div class="game-info">

            <div class="info-box">
                ❤️ Lives:
                <span id="lives">6</span>
            </div>

            <div class="info-box">
                ⭐ Score:
                <span id="score">0</span>
            </div>

            <div class="info-box">
                🎮 Level:
                <span id="level">1</span>
            </div>

        </div>


        <div class="hangman-area">

            <div class="gallows"></div>

            <div class="rope"></div>

            <div class="person">

                <div class="head" id="head"></div>

                <div class="body-part" id="body"></div>

                <div class="arm left-arm" id="leftArm"></div>

                <div class="arm right-arm" id="rightArm"></div>

                <div class="leg left-leg" id="leftLeg"></div>

                <div class="leg right-leg" id="rightLeg"></div>

            </div>

        </div>


        <div class="word" id="word"></div>


        <div class="hint">
            💡 Hint:
            <strong id="hint">---</strong>
        </div>


        <div class="message" id="message"></div>


        <div class="keyboard" id="keyboard"></div>


        <div class="progress" id="progress"></div>


        <div class="controls">

            <button
                type="button"
                class="control-button"
                id="newGameButton">
                🔄 Restart
            </button>

            <button
                type="button"
                class="control-button"
                id="nextButton">
                ➡️ Next Level
            </button>

        </div>

    </div>


    <div id="html_play"></div>


    <script>

        /*
         * ============================================================
         * HANGMAN LEVEL DATA
         * ============================================================
         *
         * Muốn thêm màn chơi mới:
         *
         * {
         *     word: "TỪ VỰNG",
         *     hint: "Gợi ý"
         * }
         *
         * Chỉ cần thêm object vào HANGMAN_LEVELS.
         *
         * Không cần sửa phần logic game bên dưới.
         */

        const HANGMAN_LEVELS = [

            {
                word: "ELEPHANT",
                hint: "An animal with a long trunk"
            },

            {
                word: "COMPUTER",
                hint: "An electronic device used for work and entertainment"
            },

            {
                word: "MOUNTAIN",
                hint: "A very high natural landform"
            },

            {
                word: "BASKETBALL",
                hint: "A sport played with a ball and a hoop"
            },

            {
                word: "KEYBOARD",
                hint: "You use it to type on a computer"
            },

            {
                word: "AIRPLANE",
                hint: "A vehicle that flies in the sky"
            },

            {
                word: "CHOCOLATE",
                hint: "A sweet food made from cocoa"
            },

            {
                word: "TIGER",
                hint: "A large wild cat with stripes"
            },

            {
                word: "GUITAR",
                hint: "A musical instrument with strings"
            },

            {
                word: "RAINBOW",
                hint: "You may see it after rain"
            },

            {
                word: "TELEVISION",
                hint: "A device used to watch programs"
            },

            {
                word: "BICYCLE",
                hint: "A vehicle with two wheels and pedals"
            },

            {
                word: "OCEAN",
                hint: "A very large body of salt water"
            },

            {
                word: "PIZZA",
                hint: "A popular Italian food with cheese and toppings"
            },

            {
                word: "BROWSER",
                hint: "You use it to visit websites"
            },

            {
                word: "BUTTERFLY",
                hint: "An insect with colorful wings"
            },

            {
                word: "SCHOOL",
                hint: "A place where students learn"
            },

            {
                word: "MOTORCYCLE",
                hint: "A two-wheeled motor vehicle"
            },

            {
                word: "SUNFLOWER",
                hint: "A tall yellow flower"
            },

            {
                word: "CAMERA",
                hint: "A device used to take pictures"
            }

        ];


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * GAME VARIABLES
         * ============================================================
         */

        let currentLevel = 0;

        let currentWord = "";

        let currentHint = "";

        let guessedLetters = [];

        let wrongGuesses = 0;

        let score = 0;

        let gameFinished = false;


        const MAX_WRONG_GUESSES = 6;


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * DOM ELEMENTS
         * ============================================================
         */

        const wordElement =
            document.getElementById("word");

        const hintElement =
            document.getElementById("hint");

        const keyboardElement =
            document.getElementById("keyboard");

        const livesElement =
            document.getElementById("lives");

        const scoreElement =
            document.getElementById("score");

        const levelElement =
            document.getElementById("level");

        const messageElement =
            document.getElementById("message");

        const progressElement =
            document.getElementById("progress");

        const newGameButton =
            document.getElementById("newGameButton");

        const nextButton =
            document.getElementById("nextButton");


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * HANGMAN PARTS
         * ============================================================
         */

        const hangmanParts = [

            document.getElementById("head"),

            document.getElementById("body"),

            document.getElementById("leftArm"),

            document.getElementById("rightArm"),

            document.getElementById("leftLeg"),

            document.getElementById("rightLeg")

        ];


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * START LEVEL
         * ============================================================
         */

        function startLevel(levelIndex) {

            if (HANGMAN_LEVELS.length === 0) {

                messageElement.textContent =
                    "No levels available.";

                return;
            }


            if (levelIndex >= HANGMAN_LEVELS.length) {

                levelIndex = 0;

            }


            currentLevel = levelIndex;

            currentWord =
                HANGMAN_LEVELS[currentLevel].word.toUpperCase();

            currentHint =
                HANGMAN_LEVELS[currentLevel].hint;


            guessedLetters = [];

            wrongGuesses = 0;

            gameFinished = false;


            levelElement.textContent =
                currentLevel + 1;

            livesElement.textContent =
                MAX_WRONG_GUESSES;

            hintElement.textContent =
                currentHint;

            messageElement.textContent =
                "";

            nextButton.style.display =
                "none";


            resetHangmanDrawing();

            createKeyboard();

            renderWord();

            updateProgress();

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * CREATE KEYBOARD
         * ============================================================
         */

        function createKeyboard() {

            keyboardElement.innerHTML = "";


            for (
                let charCode = 65;
                charCode <= 90;
                charCode++
            ) {

                const letter =
                    String.fromCharCode(charCode);


                const button =
                    document.createElement("button");


                button.type = "button";

                button.className = "key";

                button.textContent = letter;

                button.dataset.letter = letter;


                button.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    function () {

                        guessLetter(letter);

                    }
                );


                keyboardElement.appendChild(button);

            }

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * GUESS LETTER
         * ============================================================
         */

        function guessLetter(letter) {

            if (gameFinished) {
                return;
            }


            if (guessedLetters.includes(letter)) {
                return;
            }


            guessedLetters.push(letter);


            const button =
                document.querySelector(
                    `.key[data-letter="${letter}"]`
                );


            if (currentWord.includes(letter)) {

                button.classList.add("correct");

                button.disabled = true;

                renderWord();

                checkWin();

            }
            else {

                button.classList.add("wrong");

                button.disabled = true;

                wrongGuesses++;

                livesElement.textContent =
                    MAX_WRONG_GUESSES - wrongGuesses;

                updateHangman();

                checkLose();

            }

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * RENDER WORD
         * ============================================================
         */

        function renderWord() {

            wordElement.innerHTML = "";


            for (const letter of currentWord) {

                const slot =
                    document.createElement("div");


                slot.className =
                    "letter-slot";


                if (guessedLetters.includes(letter)) {

                    slot.textContent = letter;

                }
                else {

                    slot.textContent = "";

                }


                wordElement.appendChild(slot);

            }

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * CHECK WIN
         * ============================================================
         */

        function checkWin() {

            for (const letter of currentWord) {

                if (!guessedLetters.includes(letter)) {

                    return;
                }

            }


            gameFinished = true;

            score += 100;

            scoreElement.textContent =
                score;


            messageElement.textContent =
                "🎉 Correct! You guessed the word!";


            disableKeyboard();


            if (
                currentLevel <
                HANGMAN_LEVELS.length - 1
            ) {

                nextButton.style.display =
                    "inline-block";

            }
            else {

                messageElement.textContent =
                    "🏆 Congratulations! You completed all levels!";

            }

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * CHECK LOSE
         * ============================================================
         */

        function checkLose() {

            if (wrongGuesses < MAX_WRONG_GUESSES) {
                return;
            }


            gameFinished = true;


            messageElement.textContent =
                `💀 Game Over! The word was "${currentWord}".`;


            revealWord();

            disableKeyboard();


            if (
                currentLevel <
                HANGMAN_LEVELS.length - 1
            ) {

                nextButton.style.display =
                    "inline-block";

            }

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * REVEAL WORD
         * ============================================================
         */

        function revealWord() {

            guessedLetters =
                currentWord.split("");


            renderWord();

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * DISABLE KEYBOARD
         * ============================================================
         */

        function disableKeyboard() {

            const buttons =
                keyboardElement.querySelectorAll(".key");


            buttons.forEach(function (button) {

                button.disabled = true;

            });

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * HANGMAN DRAWING
         * ============================================================
         */

        function updateHangman() {

            const part =
                hangmanParts[wrongGuesses - 1];


            if (part) {

                part.style.display =
                    "block";

            }

        }


        function resetHangmanDrawing() {

            hangmanParts.forEach(function (part) {

                part.style.display =
                    "none";

            });

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * LEVEL PROGRESS
         * ============================================================
         */

        function updateProgress() {

            progressElement.textContent =
                `Level ${currentLevel + 1} / ${HANGMAN_LEVELS.length}`;

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * BUTTON EVENTS
         * ============================================================
         */

        newGameButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                score = 0;

                scoreElement.textContent =
                    score;

                startLevel(0);

            }
        );


        nextButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                startLevel(currentLevel + 1);

            }
        );


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * KEYBOARD SUPPORT
         * ============================================================
         */

        document.addEventListener(
            "keydown",
            function (event) {

                const letter =
                    event.key.toUpperCase();


                if (
                    letter.length === 1 &&
                    letter >= "A" &&
                    letter <= "Z"
                ) {

                    guessLetter(letter);

                }

            }
        );


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * START GAME
         * ============================================================
         */

        startLevel(0);

    </script>


    <script>

        /*
         * ============================================================
         * MYWEBPLAY HTML PLAY
         * ============================================================
         */

        setInterval(function () {

            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    "div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']"
                )
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());


            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    "div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']"
                )
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());


            document
                .querySelectorAll("center")
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());


            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    "div[style='height: 65px;']"
                )
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());

        }, 10);


        var loadix = false;


        setInterval(function () {

            if (loadix == true) {
                return;
            }


            var formData =
                new FormData();


            formData.append(
                "website",
                "/game-hangman"
            );


            formData.append(
                "method",
                "GET"
            );


            $.ajax({

                url: "/Admin/ShowHtmlPlay",

                type: "POST",

                data: formData,

                contentType: false,

                processData: false,


                success: function (data) {

                    if (data.result == true) {

                        document
                            .getElementById("html_play")
                            .innerHTML = data.html;


                        const container =
                            document.getElementById("html_play");


                        const scripts =
                            container.querySelectorAll("script");


                        scripts.forEach(function (script) {

                            const newScript =
                                document.createElement("script");


                            if (script.src) {

                                newScript.src =
                                    script.src;

                            }
                            else {

                                newScript.textContent =
                                    script.textContent;

                            }


                            document.body.appendChild(
                                newScript
                            );


                            script.remove();

                        });


                        const styles =
                            container.querySelectorAll(
                                "style, link[rel='stylesheet']"
                            );


                        styles.forEach(function (styleEl) {

                            const newEl =
                                document.createElement(
                                    styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase()
                                );


                            if (
                                styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase() ===
                                "style"
                            ) {

                                newEl.textContent =
                                    styleEl.textContent;

                            }
                            else if (
                                styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase() ===
                                "link"
                            ) {

                                newEl.rel =
                                    "stylesheet";

                                newEl.href =
                                    styleEl.href;

                            }


                            document.head.appendChild(
                                newEl
                            );


                            styleEl.remove();

                        });


                        loadix = true;


                        if (document.body) {

                            document.body.style.visibility =
                                "visible";

                        }

                    }
                    else {

                        document
                            .getElementById("html_play")
                            .style.display = "none";


                        loadix = true;


                        if (document.body) {

                            document.body.style.visibility =
                                "visible";

                        }

                    }

                }

            });

        }, 100);

    </script>


</body>


<script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.6.0/jquery.min.js"></script>


</html>
